title: "Youssef Benzarti"

::: {.lead}
Associate Professor of Economics, University of California, Santa Barbara.
Faculty Research Fellow, National Bureau of Economic Research.
Director, Public Finance Lab, UCSB.
:::

I work on public finance: how taxes are borne, who ends up paying them, and what they cost
to comply with. Recent work covers the incidence of value-added taxes, the costs households
bear in filing tax returns, and payroll taxation.
